experiment: E5-smoke (bench
reason: Day 0 check after reflashing F/G/A. F on charge-only cable (no F log; counters from G). During flood: legit 4 of 5 attempts ok (1 timeout, next try ok 1.5 s later); 601 forged HELLOs all challenged, 0 dropped, 0 admitted. Not an energy measurement.

experiment: E_rig handshake energy + flood (F on INA219 rig)
notes: 300 s baseline: 10 handshakes, F marked op 83-562 ms, 9-65 mJ above idle (sign time varies). Idle ~603 mW (corrected). Flood: 602 challenged, legit 4/4 ok, power +3 mW (within noise). FLOOD sends random signature bytes, rejected cheaply.

experiment: E_rig flood without defence (F on INA219 rig)
notes: 370 forged HELLOs rejected (hs_fail), 190 busy_drop; each marked reject ~1.7 ms, ~0.15 mJ above idle; mean power unchanged within noise (604.8 vs 607.8 mW). Legit 3 ok / 4 fail during flood (connectivity, not energy).

experiment: E_rig INSIDER without defence (F on INA219 rig)
notes: F power 601 -> 705 mW (+104 mW, +17 %) during attack; +12.6 J over 121 s; 293 HELLOs answered (spend), 260 busy_drop; 268 marked ops ~107 ms, ~13 mJ above idle each; ~43 mJ per answered HELLO incl. radio. Legit 2 ok / 6 fail.

experiment: E_rig INSIDER with gate (F on INA219 rig)
notes: F power unchanged within noise (605 -> 604 mW); 551 challenged, 8 spent, 0 dropped; legit 4/4 ok. Attacker does not echo cookies; ECHO-insider not yet tested.
